title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: recomputing the charges due from the acceptance's account
content:
## Rule
For applying a remittance under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the charges due on the acceptance are recomputed from its account rather than read from the balance shown on the acceptance. They are the total of every surcharge-type charge row, late declaration fee row, amendment-type fee row, withdrawal fee row and misdeclaration-type charge row, less the total of every payment row and every waiver row, all taken over the acceptance's whole life. The difference, a whole number of cents, is stated to two decimal places.

## Which rows count, and in which direction
| Rows on the acceptance's account | Direction |
|---|---|
| surcharge-type rows — the administration fee, the hazardous-cargo surcharge and the marine pollutant surcharge | in |
| late declaration fee rows | in |
| amendment-type rows — the amendment fee and the re-review fee | in |
| withdrawal fee rows | in |
| misdeclaration-type rows — the misdeclaration penalty and the inspection cost recovery | in |
| payment rows | out |
| waiver rows | out |

## Worked case (hypothetical account)
Administration fee 41.00, hazardous-cargo surcharge 812.40 and amendment fee 130.00 in; one payment of 500.00 and one waiver of 130.00 out. Total in: 983.40. Total out: 630.00. Charges due: 983.40 less 630.00, that is 353.40 — whatever balance the acceptance itself happens to display.

## Points of judgement
- *May the balance printed on the acceptance be used instead?* No; the charges due are recomputed from the rows on the account.
- *Are rows from before a re-review or a second approval left out?* No; every row over the acceptance's whole life is taken.
